verdict.rationale: Exporting all data in open formats is a fair question for a SaaS marketing platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party bulk or full-account export. The only related item is a Marketing Emails API GET endpoint for retrieving emails, which is a developer building block covering one object type, not a documented export-and-leave capability. The Salesforce sync is an adjacent integration, not data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`
